title: UTILITY CUSTOM MOVESETS V3 EXAMPLE
features:
+ means new, = means fixes, ? Means testing later
• Custom Movesets V3 is Custom movesets V2 but..
  + Added the rest of the characters to ChrSel
  + Added Custom VFX importing (returns the part of the .rbxm or the first part within the model in the .rbxm)
  = Fixed only 1 move max glitch
  + Function: ChrSel, adds character to character select, Syntax: ms:ChrSel(moveset name, image id (number or string), notice description (e.g. “Moveset made by <your name>”), onRespawnAfterClick (function)
  + Function: Bind, Binds an animation to a function, syntax: ms:Bind(AnimationId (e.g. “rbxassetid://000000”), callback (function with syntax function(AnimationTrack)))
  ? Idk if PC support is here yet.. I’m working on it!
•

Soon:
  + Non-Auto Use support
  + Support for changing character name colors
  + Support for up to 2 movesets for scripts
  + ult bar ui changing
